headline: Cleanse, treat with 10% Niacinamide, finish with SPF
footnote: Serum: apply 2-3 drops after cleansing & toning, AM & PM.
layout_description: Square 1080x1080. Headline across the top band. Three real pack shots stand in a row across the middle 80% of the frame in routine order (cleanser, serum, sunscreen), the serum slightly forward as the hero. A short label sits under each pack. CTA bottom-left, footnote along the bottom edge.
image_prompt: Square 1080x1080 background plate only. A long, low off-white shelf-like surface running across the frame against a seamless pale cool-grey wall, lit by soft, even natural daylight from the front-right with very soft shadows. Clinical, minimal and uncluttered, palette of off-white, pale grey and a hint of soft aqua, no props in the centre. Keep the middle 80% of the frame as clear, evenly lit empty space along the surface, reserved for three photos composited later. Keep the top band calm and low-detail as empty space for copy added later. No product, no bottle, no packaging, no text, no letters, no logos, no people, no faces, no skin, no hands.
adaptation_notes: Kept: the bundle/kit structure (several of the brand's own packs shown together, one Shop now CTA), rebuilt as an honest range guide in routine order using only the companion products provided. Dropped: the 'buy any 3 @ price' bundle offer and code (no bundle exists on our pages), urgency, emoji, the youthful-skin promise and the colourful acrylic set. Routine order cites F13 (serum after cleansing & toning).

verdict.label: Fix before review
verdict.detail: Change the flagged lines, or attach the substantiation a reviewer would need to accept them.

findings.message: 'Treat' / 'treatment' positions a cosmetic as a treatment.
findings.fix: Use a cosmetic verb: 'target', 'care for', 'help with the look of'. For routine steps, use 'Serum' or 'Step 2' instead of 'Treat'.
